methodology.correctness_gate_order: all required scenarios before any performance samples
methodology.warmup_strategy: contract warmup_count per operation before interleaved samples
methodology.sample_interleaving_strategy: alternating_per_sample: even sample append-first, odd sqlite-first
methodology.timing_source: std::time::Instant elapsed wall clock per operation
methodology.peak_memory_strategy: process peak RSS via getrusage (unix) or GetProcessMemoryInfo PeakWorkingSetSize (windows); subprocess-isolated per measurement sample
methodology.bytes_read_write_strategy: unavailable unless candidate-neutral filesystem observation exists
methodology.storage_size_strategy: recursive byte sum of candidate session storage directory; storage_size_before unavailable for isolated per-sample roots
methodology.environment_metadata_strategy: capture_environment at run start from live host
methodology.comparison_algorithm: paired within-platform tradeoff report without cross-platform pooling
methodology.missing_metric_policy: explicit unavailable sentinel; never encode as zero
methodology.capability_dependent_policy: unsupported capability yields ScenarioExecutionStatus::Unsupported with limitation
